{{Short description|Polish scientist (born 1959)}}
{{BLP sources|date=October 2020}}

'''Sabina Nowak''' ({{IPA|pl|saˈbi.na nɔvak}}; married name '''Pierużek-Nowak;''' born 6 June 1959)<ref>''[http://www.w.osoby-krs.pl/Pieru%C5%BCek%20Nowak.html Sabina Pierużek Nowak − Profil Osoby z KRS] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241126230914/http://www.w.osoby-krs.pl/Pieru%C5%BCek%20Nowak.html |date=2024-11-26 }}''</ref> is a Polish scientist and wolf expert. She is president of the Association for Nature Wolf (AfN Wolf)<ref>ResearchGate: ''[https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Sabina_Nowak3 Sabina Nowak - President of Association for Nature "Wolf"]''</ref> and a member of the [[Large Carnivore Initiative for Europe]].<ref>[[Large Carnivore Initiative for Europe]]: ''[https://www.lcie.org/About-LCIE/-Who-are-we Who we are]''</ref>

== Life ==
In 1983, Nowak graduated from the [[University of Silesia in Katowice]] with a ''Master of Science'' degree in biology.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Nowa Nauka Polska |url=https://nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=122241&_k=nrpvwe |access-date=2024-01-17 |website=nauka-polska.pl}}</ref> In her doctoral thesis she described the "Ecology of Wolves". She has been taking care of the [[wolf]] in Poland since the mid-1990s. From 1993 to 1998 she coordinated the campaign "For the full protection of the large predators, wolf and lynx" in Poland and a campaign for the protection of the entire Polish part of the primeval forest Białowieża as a national park ([[Białowieża National Park]]). In 1998 she was elected to the Ashoka Fellowship.<ref>Ashoka:''[https://www.ashoka.org/de-de/fellow/sabina-pieruzek-nowak Sabina Pieruzek-Nowak]''</ref><ref>Ashoka: ''[https://ashoka-cee.org/slovakia/fellow/sabina-pieruzek-nowak/ Sabina Pierużek-Nowak - Date of election Poland 1998]''</ref> From 2001 to 2004 she was head of the Polish census of lynxes and wolves. Since 2000, she has been coordinating German-Polish cooperation on wolves with the German wolf experts [[Ilka Reinhardt]] and [[Gesa Kluth]]. From 2009 to 2016 she was a member of the Polish State Council for Nature Conservation, where she chaired the Animals Commission from 2014 to 2016.<ref>''[https://www.polskiwilk.org.pl/o-nas Stowarzyszenie Dla Natury "Wilk"]''</ref>

2015 Sabina Nowak and [[Henryk Okarma]] were speakers at a conference in the Senate "The Future of the Wolf in Poland" concerning the fast growing wolf population in Poland.<ref>''[http://www.uwm.edu.pl/kliel/?p=1236 Przyszłość wilka w Polsce] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201023023107/http://www.uwm.edu.pl/kliel/?p=1236 |date=2020-10-23 }}''</ref><ref>[[International Fund for Animal Welfare|IFAW]]: ''[https://www.ifaw.org/de/press-releases/neue-zahlen-mehr-wolfsrudel-in-westpolen Neue Zahlen: Mehr Wolfsrudel in Westpolen]''</ref>
